rules.structure: Structure = Frame x 5 unless the entry says otherwise. It works like Stamina.
rules.surge: A vehicle's Surge ceiling is its Frame. Surge generates Heat in vehicles that track it.
rules.crew: Every crew member acts on their own initiative using their own Actions.

flags: Vehicle design is in progress (author). Only the Motorcycle has final Structure (7 boxes: Healthy 2, Hurt 2, Injured 2, Broken 1).

stats.name: Frame
stats.text: Size class. Sets scale, base Structure, and what the vehicle can meaningfully damage or be damaged by. The single most important number.

stats.name: Structure
stats.text: The vehicle's pool. Works exactly like Stamina — boxes cross as damage lands, and threshold bands apply the same penalties.

stats.name: Handling
stats.text: Applied to every Pilot check. A fighter is +2; a loaded freighter is -2.

stats.name: Speed
stats.text: Range bands crossed with one Move action. Also the ceiling on how many bands it can close in a round.

stats.name: Armor
stats.text: Damage reduction against attacks of equal Frame. Scale rules apply before Armor.

frames.examples: A character on foot, in powered armor, or riding an animal
Motorcycle · rowboat · glider · horse and cart · scout drone
Car · truck · patrol boat · light aircraft · light mech
Tank · fighter craft · trawler · assault mech · armored transport
Bomber · destroyer · dropship · siege mech · airship

scale_rule.result: Target is destroyed or removed from play. No roll needed if it cannot escape.
Double the overage. Armor still applies.
Half the overage, rounded down. Armor applies first.
No effect. A rifle does not hurt a tank. Requires a Scale-breaking weapon.

conditions.name: Crippled
conditions.effect: Speed reduced by 1. A second application halves Handling as well.

conditions.name: Disarmed
conditions.effect: One named weapon system is offline until repaired.

conditions.name: Venting
conditions.effect: Losing fuel, atmosphere, or coolant. 1 Structure box per round until sealed.

conditions.name: Breached
conditions.effect: Crew compartment is open. Crew take personal-scale damage from external effects.

conditions.name: Dead Stick
conditions.effect: No power. Speed 0, Handling -3, all Systems offline. Restart with Operate DC 14.

conditions.name: Listing
conditions.effect: Handling -2. Applies to boats taking water and aircraft losing a control surface.

stations.name: Pilot
stations.text: Moves the vehicle, evades, and makes all Handling checks. One Pilot per vehicle.

stations.name: Gunner
stations.skill_text: Agility + Combat (Ranged) (DECISIONS.md; the book says "Gunnery skill")
stations.text: Fires one weapon System per Action. Multiple gunners may fire simultaneously.

stations.name: Engineer
stations.text: Repairs one Structure box or clears one vehicle Condition per Action.

stations.name: Commander
stations.text: Grants one crew member +2 to their next check. Coordinates multi-vehicle actions.

stations.name: Sensors
stations.text: Detects, identifies, and marks targets. A marked target grants gunners +2.

actions.name: Move
actions.effect: Cross up to Speed range bands.

actions.name: Evade
actions.effect: +2 to the vehicle's Deflect until your next turn. Costs the Move action.

actions.name: Ram
actions.effect: Attack using Frame + Speed. Both vehicles take the overage; scale applies to each.

actions.name: Fire
actions.effect: Attack with one weapon System. Uses Gunnery, not personal Combat.

actions.name: Repair
actions.effect: Restore 1 Structure box, or clear one vehicle Condition.

actions.name: Surge
actions.effect: Commit Structure boxes before rolling for +1 each, exactly as a character Surges Stamina. Generates Heat in vehicles that track it.

actions.name: Eject
actions.effect: Leave the vehicle. Frame 2+ vehicles assume a survivable ejection system.

heat.effect: -2 to Gunnery. Pilot takes 1 Stamina box per round.
Movement halved. Weapons may misfire — Operate DC 12 to fire at all.
Dead Stick applied automatically. Restart with Operate DC 16.

hit_locations.result: Breached — pilot exposed and takes 2 Stamina boxes
Venting — 1 Structure per round, and Heat +2 each round

catalog.name: Motorcycle
catalog.notes: Squeezes through gaps larger vehicles cannot.

catalog.name: Sedan

catalog.name: Armored SUV
catalog.notes: Standard executive protection.

catalog.name: Speedboat
catalog.notes: Handling -2 in heavy sea.

catalog.name: AV Flyer
catalog.notes: Vertical takeoff. Corporate standard.

catalog.name: Combat Drone

catalog.name: Aether Skiff

catalog.name: Shuttle

catalog.name: Freighter

catalog.name: Corvette

catalog.name: Escape Pod
catalog.notes: Speed 2 in one direction only. Life support counted in days.

catalog.name: Scrap Buggy

catalog.name: War Rig
catalog.notes: Rolling fortress. Multiple gunner stations.

catalog.name: Salvaged Tank
catalog.notes: Runs. Ammunition is the constraint.

catalog.name: Sail Cart
catalog.notes: Wind-driven. Silent, which matters.

catalog.name: Bunker Crawler
catalog.notes: Slow, sealed, and radiation-proof.

catalog.name: Scout Mech
catalog.notes: Fast, lightly armed. Sensors station standard.

catalog.name: Line Mech

catalog.name: Siege Mech

catalog.name: Colossus
catalog.notes: Frame 5. Battlefield-defining and impossible to hide.

building.how: How big is it compared to a person? That sets Structure and scale at once.
Fast and nimble, or heavy and slow? Total the two to roughly +4 for a balanced vehicle, higher for a specialist.
0 for civilian, 1-2 for reinforced, 3-4 for military, 5 for capital-grade.
Weapons, sensors, and gear built with the five Item Templates. Two Systems for a light vehicle, up to five for capital.
